dialogues.speaker: Lechlade
dialogues.text: Dr. Arderne's medicine really worked. My headache is gone and I feel wide awake. It makes me think of the days I was able to help people like that...

dialogues.speaker: Lechlade
dialogues.text: *sigh* It's all my fault. You need to look after yourself, and take any symptom seriously, even the smallest ones...
